findings.description: The code doesn't handle the case where the buffer is too small properly.
The code doesn't validate or sanitize the path before printing it.
While the return value is checked, the error case doesn't handle the situation properly.
Using a fixed-size buffer on the stack (1024 bytes) without proper handling when it's insufficient.
